A detailed historical map of West Africa in the mid-to-late 19th century. The map shows four large shaded regions representing the major Islamic empires. In the east (modern Nigeria/Niger), a large green area. To its west (modern Mali), a yellow area. Further west and stretching across to Senegal, a purple area. In the southwest (modern Guinea/Mali/Ivory Coast border), a red-outlined area. Important cities like Sokoto, Hamdallahi, Segou, Dinguiraye, and Kankan are marked with dots.
